command.description: Shell command run when the hook fires

description.description: Human-readable description of what the hook does

event.description: Cursor hook event name; must match the key this item is listed under. Enum covers the events shipped in hooks/hooks.json; extend it if Cursor adds events.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the hook command

description: Configuration for Cursor hooks, as shipped in hooks/hooks.json. Cursor format: camelCase event names as keys, each mapping to an array of items with a command, the event name, and an optional description. This is distinct from schemas/hooks.schema.json, which describes the legacy hooks format (PascalCase events, matcher entries with {type, command} items) and does not accept this file.
title: Cursor Hooks Configuration
